title: Life Admin Pass: Legal & Tax Guide (Australia)
disclaimer: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Confirm with a registered tax agent / lawyer.

answers.abn: Yes - apply now as a sole trader (free). Needed for .com.au, avoids 47% no-ABN withholding, needed by app stores/MoRs. Business name A$47/1yr or A$108/3yr only if trading under a non-personal name. [verified]
answers.gst: Must register within 21 days once current or projected GST turnover >= A$75k (GST-free sales count; for MoR sales turnover is what the reseller pays you). Base case (~A$64k net to Apr 2028, ~A$73k/yr by 2029) puts this around FY2028-29 [assumption from base case]. Exception: Apple requires Australian developers to be GST-registered to sell paid apps; Google Play makes AU developers remit GST on AU sales themselves. [verified, Apple/Google pages]
answers.structure: Sole trader now; review a company (25% base rate, A$636 + A$342/yr ASIC) in FY2027-28 if retained profit exceeds ~A$20-50k/yr [rule of thumb, assumption].

Non-commercial loss rules: income requirement under A$250k plus one test
Instant asset write-off A$20k (permanent from 1 Jul 2026)
Quarterly BAS due 28 Oct, 28 Feb, 28 Apr, 28 Jul
Super guarantee 12%, payday super from 1 Jul 2026; NSW workers comp needed above A$7,500 wages
ACL guarantees apply to digital products; 'no refunds' unlawful; UCT penalties apply
Unfair Trading Practices Act 2026 (No. 64) starts 1 Jul 2027: subscription rules, dark patterns, drip pricing
Privacy A$3M small business exemption remains; statutory privacy tort from 10 Jun 2025
